name: browser-use
headline: aissist AI CLI for goal tracking and reflections
short_description: Aissist is a local-first, AI-powered CLI assistant that tracks goals, reflections, and context in Markdown. It helps operations teams manage tasks, plan workflows, and maintain context across projects. Integrates with Claude for AI-powered insights and automation.
author: albertnahas

sections.overview:
Aissist is a CLI-based personal assistant that helps you connect your past, present, and future through human-readable Markdown files stored locally on your machine. It tracks goals with AI-generated codenames and deadlines, logs daily activities and reflections, and organizes information by context (work, fitness, diet, etc.). The tool integrates with Claude Code to provide AI-powered semantic search across your history, generate action proposals based on your goals, and offer guided reflection prompts. All data is stored in version-control-friendly Markdown format, supporting both global (~/.aissist/) and project-specific (./.aissist/) storage modes. Aissist is designed for individuals and operations teams who need to maintain searchable context across projects while keeping sensitive information local and private.
Track personal and professional goals with deadlines and progress notes
Log daily activities and search your history semantically with Claude integration
Generate AI-powered action proposals based on your goals and activity history
Maintain project-specific context and documentation in version-controlled Markdown
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/albertnahas/aissist`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze my Aissist Markdown files from [PROJECT_NAME] in [INDUSTRY] and identify patterns in [SPECIFIC_METRIC] over the past [TIME_PERIOD]. Provide actionable insights to improve efficiency and suggest automation opportunities.
```
Copy

```
# Analysis of [PROJECT_NAME] Efficiency Patterns
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
